<div class="wrap" markdown="1">

{% raw %}
`/feedback` lets you say something to the league's officers without them knowing who said it. Your name is never recorded: not stored, not logged, not hidden somewhere the officers could look it up.

## Sending something

1. Run `/feedback` in the server. The bot sends you a **direct message**, so nothing you write can end up in the channel by mistake.
2. In that DM, choose what it is: a **comment**, **question**, **suggestion** or **complaint**.
3. Write your message in the form that opens, and send it.

If the bot says it could not message you, allow direct messages from the server's members (right-click the server, **Privacy Settings**, **Direct Messages**) and run `/feedback` again.

You get a **reference code** such as `F-AB12CD`. **Write it down**: it is the only way to see a reply. The bot keeps no record of who sent the message, so it cannot send you the answer.

## Who reads it

Most choices go to **all officers**. If it is about an officer, choose one marked **Archon only**: it goes to the league leader's direct messages and nobody else.

Your message arrives a few minutes after you send it (up to 15 minutes, on purpose), so the time it arrives does not point to you.

## Getting a reply

Choose **📬 Check for a reply** in the same DM (or run `/feedback` again for a fresh one), then enter your code. You will see whether it has been delivered or dealt with, and any replies.

Officers can also answer **publicly** in the league's feedback answers channel, under your code. A public answer shows only their reply, never your message.

## What to know

- **What you write is the one thing the bot cannot protect.** If your message mentions something only you would know, it can point to you.
- Messages the officers have marked as dealt with are deleted after a while (your server sets 30 to 90 days); the check screen shows the date. Messages not yet dealt with are kept.
- To stop misuse there are limits: 3 messages an hour each, and a daily limit for the whole server.
{% endraw %}
